# Third-party libraries

These files are bundled unmodified so the app works offline. Each keeps its own license.

| File | Library | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `marked.min.js` | [marked](https://github.com/markedjs/marked) | 12.0.2 | MIT |
| `purify.min.js` | [DOMPurify](https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify) | 3.1.6 | Apache-2.0 or MPL-2.0 |
| `cytoscape.min.js` | [Cytoscape.js](https://github.com/cytoscape/cytoscape.js) | 3.30.2 | MIT |
| `katex/` (js, css, fonts) | [KaTeX](https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX) | 0.16.11 | MIT |
| `mermaid.min.js` | [Mermaid](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid) | 11.4.1 | MIT |
